name: Question 13
worked_solution:
We're given that $Z∼N(0,1),$ and we wish to compute $P(-0.92<Z<-0.18).$ The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069404/assets/34132169270b3259fb1be909f7aea2474e4dff1375603e9b9a75e013900f6340.png)

By the definition of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z),$ 

$$
P(Z\le z)=Φ(z).
$$

So, we express the required probability in terms of $Φ(z)$:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(-0.92<Z<-0.18) & =P(Z<-0.18)-P(Z\le -0.92) \\  & =P(Z\le -0.18)-P(Z\le -0.92) \\  & =Φ(-0.18)-Φ(-0.92).\end{aligned}
$$

From the tables, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(-0.92) & =0.1788 \\ Φ(-0.18) & =0.4286\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(-0.92<Z<-0.18) & =Φ(-0.18)-Φ(-0.92) \\  & =0.4286-0.1788 \\  & =0.2498.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

We're given that Z∼N(0,1), and we wish to compute P(−0.92<Z<−0.18). The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

By the definition of the cumulative distribution function Φ(z), P(Z≤z)=Φ(z).

So, we express the required probability in terms of Φ(z): P(−0.92<Z<−0.18)=P(Z<−0.18)−P(Z≤−0.92)=P(Z≤−0.18)−P(Z≤−0.92)=Φ(−0.18)−Φ(−0.92).

From the tables, we have the following: Φ(−0.92)=0.1788Φ(−0.18)=0.4286

Therefore, we have P(−0.92<Z<−0.18)=Φ(−0.18)−Φ(−0.92)=0.4286−0.1788=0.2498.
